register_http_url_handler: register an HTTP URL handler with PathManager to support reading files from http, https, and ftp URLs
chunk_file_split: split a large file into a specified number of chunks by line count and write them to a working directory
chunk_file_parallel: chunk a large text file into N parts for parallel processing across multiple workers
register_http_url_handler_override: register an HTTP URL handler with PathManager allowing override of existing handlers
chunk_file_return_paths: split a file into chunks and return the list of output file paths for downstream use
